migration_note: This manifest is the canonical active execution state. Existing long-form Work audits and handoff documents remain reference material and should not be maintained as competing progress trackers.

tasks.title: Create Tourify engineering constitution
acceptance: Invariant Tourify safety, reuse, testing, tracking, and completion rules exist in one canonical file.

tasks.title: Capture verified Work baseline
acceptance: Baseline is anchored to an exact main commit.
Verified current behavior is separated from historical/unverified assumptions.

tasks.title: Index the Work reference build
acceptance: Reference branch and exact reusable file paths are recorded.
Reuse strategy and do-not-duplicate rules are explicit.

tasks.title: Audit current Work database schema and RLS
acceptance: Current Work tables, columns, constraints, policies, RPCs, and ownership boundaries are recorded.
Historical schema proposals are either mapped to an existing canonical equivalent or remain explicitly proposed.

tasks.title: Index current Work routes, APIs, services, messaging, notifications, documents, tours, events, jobs, and staffing dependencies
acceptance: Exact current paths and canonical owners are added to the Work baseline/reference map.
No subsystem is marked missing merely because it is absent from the historical reference path.

tasks.title: Close Work discovery baseline
acceptance: Work baseline confidence can be changed from partial_verified to verified for the implementation scope.
No unresolved canonical ownership conflicts remain for WORK-P01.

phases.title: Work Mode read model and Work Hub reconciliation

tasks.title: Define the current-to-reference Work Mode contract reconciliation
acceptance: One server-authorized read-model boundary is selected or the current alternative is explicitly justified.
Assignment ownership and error contracts are explicit.
Current working behavior is preserved.

tasks.title: Reconcile Work Mode shared types
acceptance: Current and required reference concepts use one shared typed contract.
No duplicate client-only Work assignment contract remains without a documented compatibility reason.

tasks.title: Reconcile Work Hub dashboard composition
targets: current Work routes and components identified in P00
acceptance: Existing current components are reused before reference UI is copied.
Applications, engagements, assignments, tours/events, attention, and operational summaries have explicit data owners.
Loading, empty, partial, error, and permission states are represented.

tasks.title: Preserve and integrate worker task lifecycle
targets: current task service/API identified in P00
acceptance: Assigned workers can acknowledge, start, complete, and block tasks where authorized.
Blocked tasks require a reason where the reference behavior requires it.
Unauthorized workers cannot mutate another worker's task.
No duplicate task backend is introduced.

tasks.title: Reconcile attendance, acknowledgement, cache, offline, and realtime behavior
targets: current Work APIs identified in P00
acceptance: Worker mutations receive live server confirmation.
Offline behavior cannot fabricate attendance state.
Cached reads are scoped to the authenticated worker if retained.
Realtime is optional/resilient and has a deterministic refresh fallback.

tasks.title: Verify Work Mode and Work Hub reconciliation
acceptance: Targeted tests pass.
Typecheck passes or pre-existing failures are isolated with evidence.
Build passes at phase gate or pre-existing failures are isolated with evidence.
Evidence file records changed files, tests, migrations, authorization checks, regressions, and blockers.
